label: Assam tributary floods (Jun 2026)
subtitle: Slow-onset rainfall flood - the case legacy systems handle
mechanism: Cloudburst-driven tributary surge meeting the mainstem peak
teaches: Here dual-channel and rainfall-only agree almost exactly. Shown deliberately: the claim is not that existing systems are useless, it is that they have one specific blind spot. On their home mechanism they work.
